title: Answer: no theory of space, whose real nature physics leaves dark

statements.text: The view offers no theory of space. Goff holds that physics gives only a mathematical conception of spatiotemporal relations, so their real nature is unknown, and suggests that the spatial relation may be the phenomenal bonding relation.

sources.quote: it seems we are completely in the dark about the real nature of spatiotemporal relationships
there is an obvious candidate for identification with the phenomenal bonding relation: the spatial relation
